name: Scorched Drifter's Manual
description: Margin notes in grease-pencil detailing Kestrel distress beacons and emergency plasma venting.

name: Kestrel Sigil-Drive Blackbox
description: A soot-blackened crystalline cylinder humming with pre-breach telemetry and ley-line coordinates.

name: Phase-Vanishing Plasma Carbine
description: A heavy frontier plasma rifle wrapped in silver phase-coils. Its bolts flicker out of realspace to bypass ward-shields.

name: Monolith Tuning Fork
description: A slate-black shard that vibrates whenever deep-rim anomalies wake. Worth a fortune—or a doorway.

name: Lead-Wrapped Choir Urn
description: A sealed ceramic-and-quartz cylinder humming in three-part harmony beneath lead foil.

name: Vane-Kael's Private Audit
description: Encrypted Buoy 14 filings proving Collector Vane-Kael diverted Siltport's tariffs to fund Deep Frontier containment black-site Anchor-9.

name: Taren's Brass Ley-Compass
description: A battered navigator's compass whose needle ignores magnetic north and trembles toward Pre-Collapse monoliths.

name: Captain Tessa's Echo-Core
description: A frost-rimed flight recorder from the Starling proving the Singing Monolith is a stabilizing keystone, not a weapon.

name: Cantrix Vey's Harmonic Key
description: A silver-and-quartz resonator tuned by the Listening Abbey to harmonize the Deep Frontier Lattice.

name: Anchor-9 Scuttling Override
description: Cold-iron command key for Anchor-9's grounding lances and containment ring.
